verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a REST API that can list connections, data stores and audit logs, and an MCP server that can manage account contents. These are developer building blocks a user could use to build an export. They are not a documented, first-party export-all-data feature in open formats. Nothing in the pack describes a data or account export function, export of scenario definitions (blueprints) in open formats, or an account-exit flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
